The tallest (highest) mountain in the world above sea level is **Mount Everest**, standing at **8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet)**. It is located in the Himalayas on the border between Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.

*(Note: If measured from its underwater base on the ocean floor to its peak, **Mauna Kea** in Hawaii is the tallest mountain overall at about 10,210 meters / 33,500 feet, though only 4,207 meters / 13,803 feet of it rises above sea level.)*
